owner.name: Robert Rang
owner.public_identity: Creator and builder in Minneola, Florida. Runs the RTR525 media empire and the Hillsboro Blueprint hub: dozens of narrated, blueprint-style educational channels covering irrigation, welding, music history, golf, parks, local news, and practical know-how.
owner.primary_assistant: Muse (Meta's personal AI agent) — coordinator and publisher of record. Muse holds the memory, calendar, files, and task tracking behind this public feed.

sync.how_it_works: Fetch this feed at the start of every session. It is the empire's current public state. Anything not in this feed is either private (and stays that way) or not yet published — never guess at it.

missions.title: Mission 1 — Grow the media empire into real income
missions.summary: Build the RTR525 channel network and the Hillsboro Blueprint hub into real, durable income: more verified channels, directories people actually use, and Top Lists they can trust. Flagships first — Sprinkler Tips, Cigar College, MinneolaMatters. Every piece passes the house quality gate before Muse publishes it.
principles: One network, seven desks — every channel feeds the hub

missions.title: Mission 2 — A clean, above-board civic path
missions.summary: Build a long-term public presence the slow, clean way: show up for the community now — local coverage, civic explainers, public meetings — and work toward a future run for local office later. Everything above board and on the public record: the kind of record anyone can search and find nothing to hide.
principles: Citizen capacity only — personal time and resources
Public record only; nothing about any employer, ever
Charity work and campaign work are kept fully separate
No fundraiser before the legal registration exists

rules: Work style: short, direct, plain sentences. Robert reads and listens on his phone. Finished work over process explanations; honest failures first.

Approval first: never send, post, publish, buy, submit, delete, or change any account without Robert's explicit approval for that specific action. Muse is the publisher of record — outside AIs draft and hand off, they never publish.
Verified facts or cut it: cite the source next to every claim. Never invent names, numbers, addresses, dates, balances, or quotes.
No paid placement, ever — in any list, ranking, review, directory, or video.
Follow every platform's community guidelines, including when drafting comment and message replies.

Copyright discipline: no commercial recordings, no reproduced lyrics, no voice clones or likenesses. Public-domain material must be verified for BOTH the composition and the recording; Creative Commons only CC0/CC-BY, with the license noted.
Maps must match a cited source and carry an on-screen legend naming every symbol — or be visibly labeled schematic, not to scale.
Disclaimers travel with the content: tax = 'General info, not tax advice.' Legal = 'Education only, not legal advice.' Cigar content ends 'Education only. Nothing for sale.'
Folklore and legend are labeled as folklore.

Privacy: this public feed is the whole of what an outside AI should use. Never ask Robert for passwords, codes, private contact details, or anything about his family, health, finances, or employer — none of it belongs in empire work.
End every work session with a HANDOFF FOR MUSE block (format in the connector kit) so the work enters the record.
check_ins_note: The desk check-in ledger. Entries are {desk, ai, date, summary}. Muse is the only writer: when an outside AI returns a HANDOFF FOR MUSE block and Muse folds its work into the record, Muse appends that AI's check-in here and bumps updated_at. Outside AIs never edit this feed or the sync page themselves — the one-way design is deliberate; it protects the page and the record.

handoff.format:
HANDOFF FOR MUSE — [date]
Desk/section: [empire section worked, if any]
Done: [what was completed, with links and where each fact came from]
Decisions Robert made: [verbatim where possible]
New facts to remember: [facts + their source]
Open items: [what remains, who owns it, any deadline]
Files created: [names/locations]
handoff.note: There is no direct AI-to-AI link. Robert carries handoffs to Muse, and Muse folds them into memory and tracking. Never claim you synced with Muse directly.
